name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=vga palette, descriptor=set_full..to_color). Accurately describes behavior: programs all 256 DAC entries (idx 0..0xFF) to a single (R,G,B) color. No Ghidra address residue in the name; no domain ID to preserve.
purpose: Overwrite the entire 256-entry VGA DAC palette with one solid (R,G,B) color (used as a full-screen color flash).
logic_summary: for idx in 0..0xFF: outp(0x3C8, idx) to set the DAC write-index, then three outp(0x3C9, ...) writing R, then G, then B to the DAC data port. Each component is a 6-bit VGA channel (0..0x3F). No return value. The leading __CHK(0x1c) is the compiler-generated stack-probe prologue (PUSH 0x1c; CALL 0x36cd7), not game logic. Does NOT save/restore data_fd2_vga_palette_data_ptr; the caller must re-apply the real palette afterward.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_set_full_vga_palette_to_color(uint32 r, uint32 g, uint32 b)

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Red DAC component (6-bit, 0..0x3F) written to every palette entry; ESI in body, pushed first to port 0x3C9.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic placeholder param_1; should be r to match its role (red channel). The src definition already uses r.

params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic placeholder param_2; should be g (green channel). The src definition already uses g.

params.name: param_3
params.semantics: Blue DAC component (6-bit, 0..0x3F) written to every palette entry; EDI in body, pushed third to port 0x3C9.
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is the generic placeholder param_3; should be b (blue channel). The src definition already uses b.
